name: claude-skill-for-video
description: Alex's animation skills for Claude Code.

plugins.name: video-skills
plugins.description: Fourteen skills that make animations for reels with no footage: a 3D cartoon explainer, a stick-figure explainer, a 2D pixel-world explainer, minimal black-and-white line art, a 3D map route, a 3D exploded view that turns around the object, a minimal line graph, an isometric flow diagram, a gold coin chart, a neon canyon flight, a blueprint, a hologram HUD, a chalkboard network and a landscape poster.
